none: PAS LON-44E3F7: Roman silver denarius of Hadrian AD117-138.
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman silver denarius of Hadrian AD117-138. Obverse is bust of Hadrian facing right with laurel wreath and a beaded border. Legend reads HADRIANUS AUGUSTUS PP. Reverse depicts Africa seated holding a scorpion and a cornucopia with a modius containing ears of wheat and legend COS III. Weight: 3.36g. Diameter: 18.03mm
